name: Database reactivation as a service
one_liner: Take a small business's old customer list and send it email/SMS offers that bring back repeat sales, paid by commission.
customer: Local service businesses with past-customer lists (tree trimming, trades, salons, clinics)
offer: A one-off reactivation campaign by email or SMS, plus optional always-on automations (birthday and anniversary coupons)
how_it_makes_money: About 10% of the revenue the campaign brings in. The transcript example: emailing 4,000 past customers earns the agency about $4K. Can be followed by a retainer for ongoing automations and upsells
time_to_first_revenue: weeks (one campaign can pay out right after it sends)
evidence: 'You take 10% of that as the agency owner, and you make four grand just for sending an email' - D9Q2rpO0ko8
Host owns a tree trimming business with a 4,000-person list and knows its conversion rates - D9Q2rpO0ko8
risks: UK GDPR/PECR consent rules limit marketing to old lists
Commission revenue is hard to track and attribute
Clients struggle to find or export their customer list

name: Niche AI agent agency (no-code)
one_liner: Build and run AI agents for SMBs that handle lead qualification, outreach, customer support and inbox triage.
customer: SMBs that lack the time or know-how to set up AI agents
offer: Agent setup from templates, plus a monthly management fee
how_it_makes_money: Setup fee plus a monthly retainer. One Lindy agency is said to be approaching $10K/month
evidence: 'He's starting to generate like $10,000 a month with his Lindy agency' - CNzMpxkwaPo
Most common uses: sales lead generation, customer support, personal assistant - CNzMpxkwaPo
risks: The case is anecdotal and comes from the platform's founder
Clients may churn once they learn the tools themselves

name: AI UGC ad creative studio for e-commerce
one_liner: Produce large batches of ad variations using AI avatars that hold the brand's physical product.
customer: Shopify and DTC brands running paid social ads
offer: Monthly packs of AI-generated UGC video ads, with winners chosen for testing
how_it_makes_money: Per-pack or monthly retainer pricing, undercutting human creators (about $100 per video). Claimed potential is about $80K/month for one person
evidence: 'I used to pay them $100 per video... 10 different ad variations, that's a grand' - E1mdDql_2yI
'one person business that can easily make like 80 grand a month' (a claim, not proven) - E1mdDql_2yI
risks: Brands can buy the tools directly
Ads may not perform, and the $80K figure is speculative

name: B2B webinar repurposing service
one_liner: Turn B2B companies' monthly webinars into content assets using transcripts, Claude and Canva.
customer: B2B companies that run webinars (over 60% run one monthly, per the transcript)
offer: Webinar-to-content packages such as posts, carousels and lead magnets
how_it_makes_money: About $4K per engagement, as cited in the transcript
evidence: 'Over 60% of B2B businesses run a webinar every month' - E1mdDql_2yI
'It's four grand and it's like literally all you're doing is transcript... Claude, Canva' - E1mdDql_2yI
risks: The $4K price comes from a fragment and isn't detailed (weak)
Clients could do the work in-house with AI

name: Content multiplication agent for creators/SMBs
one_liner: Run a hosted AI agent that turns one piece of content into many posts for different platforms.
customer: Creators and small businesses that publish content
how_it_makes_money: Monthly subscription or retainer (not stated in the transcript)
startup_cost: low (Hostinger VPS plus AI API costs)
evidence: Tutorial builds a 'content multiplication agent'; no revenue given (weak) - AA-EL571oG4
